title: Minimum Operations to Make the Array K-Increasing
goal: Change as few values as possible so every k-spaced subsequence is nondecreasing.
strategy: Indices with the same remainder modulo k are independent. Keep a longest nondecreasing subsequence in each chain, found with upper-bound tails, and change the other positions.
